stem.text: An ore contains magnesium carbonate and barium carbonate. A sample of the ore is dissolved in nitric acid.
How could this solution be processed into a magnesium compound and a separate barium compound?

A.text: Add $\text{HCl}\text{(aq)}$, filter off the solid barium chloride.

B.text: Add $\text{HCl}\text{(aq)}$, filter off the solid magnesium chloride.

C.text: Add $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4\text{(aq)}$, filter off the solid barium sulfate.

D.text: Add $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4\text{(aq)}$, filter off the solid magnesium sulfate.
